title: Grogu
description: Having trained at the Jedi temple on Coruscant, Grogu found himself hunted by Imperial remnant for their cloning experiments. When The Mandalorian, Din Djarin, rescued the mysterious foundling, he took it upon himself to reunite Grogu with the Jedi. Curious and powerful in the Force, Grogu found himself more interested in a life training with the Mandalorian than with the Jedi.
